localityInfo.description: Khoraj is a locality, situated on National Highway 8C in Ahmedabad, the high class developed capital city of Gujarat. This place offers visitors beautiful landscapes and picturesque skylines here. This locality is famous for the presence of famous Vaishnodevi Temple of the city in the stone’s throw away distance from the area. This locale is excellently connected with the main city and the other suburb area and neighboring cities of here by broad highways like National Highway 8C. The famous Sardar Ballav Patel ring road is also located here offering an excellent connection to this locality. The nearest airport is Ahmedabad Airport and it is located at a short driving distance from here. Khodiyar Railway Station is the nearest station from this place. Nirma University, Hiramani School and SGVP International School are the reputed educational institutes near by. This place is booming due its strategic location and excellent environment and is a good location to settle in.
